facts.claim: System uses 3-tier Edge AI & IoT architecture: Tier 1A (ESP32 sensor/actuator nodes), Tier 1B (Raspberry Pi Edge AI nodes), Tier 2 (4G LTE Gateway), Tier 3 (Cloud Layer)

ESP32-WROOM-32D runs FreeRTOS, reads 5 sensors (SHT31, BH1750, MQ-135, DHT22, MAX9814), drives 4 relays (misting, ventilation, heating, light), executes closed-loop PID control, publishes via MQTT over TLS QoS 1
Raspberry Pi 4 (4GB) receives RTSP from IP Camera PoE 4MP, runs YOLOv8/YOLOv10 + ByteTrack for swiftlet counting and predator detection (rat, snake, owl), publishes results via MQTT
Router 4G LTE Cat4 acts as edge gateway providing local LAN/Wi-Fi to ESP32 and PoE switch for IP Camera, uplinks to cloud via 4G
EMQX/Mosquitto MQTT Broker handles pub/sub message routing between edge devices and cloud backend with TLS 1.2+ and device certificate authentication
Node.js + Express.js backend with Mongoose ORM, socket.io WebSocket, JWT auth, handles REST API, MQTT subscription, telemetry aggregation, and alert processing
MongoDB stores telemetry time-series, farm/house/zone hierarchy, user accounts, alerts, bird count records
Redis provides caching and session management for horizontal scaling
S3/MinIO stores alert snapshots and video clips, accessed via presigned URLs with 15-minute TTL
Alert Engine classifies alerts into 4 severity levels (CRITICAL/HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW), sends notifications via Firebase FCM Push, Zalo ZNS, and SMS (Twilio/ESMS), with deduplication and quiet hours
ReactJS + Vite PWA dashboard with TailwindCSS, Chart.js, socket.io-client for real-time updates, installable on iOS/Android
IP Camera PoE 4MP Starlight with Smart IR 30m, RTSP streaming at 2K resolution 30FPS, powered via PoE switch
5 sensors: SHT31 (temp/humidity), BH1750 (light), MQ-135 (NH3/CO2), DHT22 (outdoor reference), MAX9814 (microphone/audio)
4 relay-controlled actuators: misting pump, ventilation fan, heater, light control
3 user roles: Farm Owner (full access), Operator (view + manual control), Administrator (system config)

assumptions.claim: Diagram shows a single-site deployment topology with one gateway connecting to the cloud
assumptions.reason: SRS describes 1-5 buildings per owner; diagram shows representative single site
